component.name: Dayhand
component.summary: Today's tasks, quick add and reminders

description.p: Dayhand shows what is overdue, what you work on now and what is planned for today, by time, with the next days at a glance and the tasks that still need a day. Add a task with a date at the end of the line ("Call the accountant fri 2pm"), tick tasks off, and get reminders as desktop notifications. It works offline and syncs with your own Dayhand server.

Today is an agenda, as on the Mac: a strip of the next two weeks with a dot for each open task, one sentence about the day (tasks on today's plan, at a set time, repeating, overdue), and the tasks by time with a bar in their status's colour.
To plan lists the overdue tasks, those without a day and the next three days'. A wide window shows it on the right until a task is opened; a narrow one folds it in at the end of Today.
Labels are gone: Dayhand sorts tasks into projects only. The app removes the labels it kept on this computer.
Task details with offline editing, labels, checklists and read-only repeat, reminder and link previews.
Trash with restore and permanent-deletion dates; offline-first morning summary and default reminder settings.
